SELECT FROM `user`
AND (username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, password, name, avatar, email, phone, sex, birth, intro, role, pwd_question, pwd_answer, failed_count, create_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{avatar}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{birth}, #{intro}, #{role}, #{pwdQuestion}, #{pwdAnswer}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET points = GREATEST(0, points + #{delta}) WHERE id = #{id}
